# Yay! Organizations can now publish blog Articles

Published January 20, 2025

Note: Organization needs to be subscribed to Enterprise Hub to unlock this feature.

When you write a new Article on https://huggingface.co/new-blog , just select your organization in the selector here:

The Article will be listed under your organization profile, here:

That's it! This is cool.
